usedFor: Shopify spots abandoned checkouts, and Holded receives the shopper as a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create Contact” in Holded
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who leaves a checkout is saved in Holded as a contact you can follow up.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so the contact appears after a scheduled check, not at once.
